limitations: Task bootstrap: 10000 replicates, seed20261103, paired tasks with each model's four trajectories retained.
Every interval is conditional on the two trained models; it is not training-seed uncertainty.
filtered409 is a subset of supplemental500, not an independent test set; length_other retains length11 and undefined cases.
Means and sample SD use actual listed seed sets (ddof=1), with matched-seed summaries for every comparison.
Tau=10 was fixed by user before tau outcomes; only Part B inverse-inclusion coefficients change. Controller oscillation is retained.
Historical runs span older hardware/code periods; available hardware evidence is shown per run. New stages and card changes are logged.
October no-SFT PaTR/GRPO/Random K=5 benchmark batch, older code and hardware; Random reference is K=5, not this new K=2 comparator; not a paired comparison.
